about: Owner messages read in the middle of a conversation (the 9 Nov 2026 WhatsApp test, and variations): typos, autocorrect, 'sorry I meant', a change of topic while a question waits, sales figures in any words. 'today' is the date the router is given. 'open' lists what Naila is waiting on (answer_open may only name one of these); 'recent' is the conversation before the message. 'routes' lists every right route; 'expect' what else must be right (open_item, decision, and the sales fields that matter; fields not listed can be anything).
